title: Story
description: CRONICĂ story output schema — written to story.json by the LLM pipeline step.

title.description: Story title in Romanian, shown on the presenter title card.

panels.description: Ordered list of panel descriptions. Length must equal brief.panel_count.

narrator_script.description: One narrator line per panel in order. Must mirror panels[i].narrator_line_ro.

image_prompts.description: One image prompt per panel in order. Must be in English. Must mirror panels[i].image_prompt_en.

items.description: ASCII-only string (English). Romanian diacritics are not permitted.

panel_index.description: 0-based index matching the brief's panel sequence.

dialogue_ro.description: Dialogue or caption text in Romanian. Empty string if no dialogue.

image_prompt_en.description: Image generation prompt in English (ASCII only). Fed directly to ComfyUI.

narrator_line_ro.description: The narrator's voice-over line for this panel, in Romanian.

characters_in_panel.description: Archetype keys of characters appearing in this panel.
